purpose: Hypothesis-agnostic, append-only database of sources STUDIED across research loops. Decoupled from any one hypothesis: organized by SUBJECT DOMAIN (not by a study's A/B/C lenses) so a future loop on a different hypothesis can pull seed sources by domain/tag without inheriting the old question.

relationship.source-map (per study): research/<study>.source-map.<date>.md — sources organized BY that study's lenses; coupled to its hypothesis.
relationship.source-catalog (this): cross-study, domain-organized, ACCUMULATING. After each study, append its new sources here; never delete. This is the reusable bibliography / source-RAG.
relationship.research-pattern: research/harness/research-pattern.{md,json,jsonl} — the METHOD (phases + lens taxonomy). The catalog feeds step 'instantiate lenses with seedSources'.

records: Live one-per-line in source-catalog.jsonl (line-economic: grep by domain/tag, read only the lines you need). This .json is the manifest + schema + index.

recordSchema.title: what it is
recordSchema.note: one line: why durable + what it bears on

domains.agent-tooling: MCP, Claude Code/Cursor/Codex, agent frameworks, primary tool docs
domains.unix-philosophy: systems design, plain-text sovereignty, composability, data-over-code
domains.knowledge-mgmt: Zettelkasten, atomic/associative notes, PKM, digital gardens
domains.framework-tooling: framework AI-tooling done well (Laravel Boost ecosystem), convention-over-config
domains.scientific-computing: literate/reproducible knowledge, array/tensor languages, RAG/embeddings sovereignty
domains.token-economics: context/tool-cost benchmarks, caching, deferred loading, the breakpoints
domains.emergent-patterns: approaches beyond a given A/B/C set surfaced by the pattern-scout (AGENTS.md/SKILL.md/Ruler/OpenCode/engraph/OKF/DSPy/agents-as-data/etc.)

usage: grep '"kind":"primary"' ... or kind in {spec,paper,doc}        # authority filter
to seed a new study: pick domains relevant to the new hypothesis, pull those records as lens seedSources

conventions.append-only: never delete a studied source; mark superseded ones with a tag if needed
conventions.provenance: v1 records all come from the agentic-sovereignty study (2026-06-16); future studies append their new finds and may add a per-record firstSeen if mixing provenance matters
conventions.dedup: one record per URL; multi-topic sources carry multiple tags rather than duplicate entries
